name: Vincent Pait
source:
Reserved and highly rational, Vincent is almost robotic in his rules of living. Of course, not everyone understands (nor appreciates) his rules of living, and plenty of discord ensues when Vincent clashes with the MC. Despite how horrifying the MC might find Vincent, since his rules have kept him prosperous thus far in life, he sees little reason to change his ways.

Vincent is more upfront with his feelings than one might assume. He shares with the MC when he feels lonely, expresses his exact desires, and is predictable once you understand rules of living. In fact, he warns the MC about the impending punishment should they disappoint him.

[From strategy guide]
